strategy.thesis: Israel's national innovation agency (formerly the Office of the Chief Scientist, renamed 2016) is the government's non-dilutive R&D funding and investment arm; it licenses and co-funds technology incubators dedicated to medical devices, pharma and bioconvergence, and runs dedicated grant tracks for digital health, bioconvergence and biotech company R&D.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Runs/licenses the Technological Incubators Program (up to NIS 40M per incubator over a 5-year concession, e.g. Edge Medical Ventures for medical devices/bioconvergence); co-administers the National Bioconvergence Program and National Digital Health Plan; academic-to-industry bridge programs (KAMIN, NOFAR, MAGNET) fund early biotech/medtech translational research.

summary.en: Israel's national innovation agency provides non-dilutive grants, matching investment and incubator licenses across the economy, with dedicated tracks and licensed incubators for medical devices, digital health and bioconvergence/biotech.
summary.local: רשות החדשנות הישראלית היא הזרוע הממשלתית למימון מו"פ ותמיכה בחדשנות, כולל מסלולים ומדגרות טכנולוגיות ייעודיות לתחומי המכשור הרפואי, הבריאות הדיגיטלית וההתכנסות הביולוגית (ביו-קונברגנס).

Established as the Office of the Chief Scientist in 1965 ... technological incubators spread across Israel in sectors such as Medical Devices, Pharma, Bioconvergence, Agricultural technology, Foodtech, Renewable Energy and more.

strategy.thesis: A multi-ministry national program (Israel Innovation Authority, Planning and Budgeting Committee/VATAT, Defense Ministry R&D directorate/MAFAT, Ministry of Innovation Science and Technology, Health Ministry and Finance Ministry) building bioconvergence infrastructure, research excellence and human capital to establish Israel as a hub merging biology, engineering and computation for health and biomanufacturing applications.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: First phase (2023-2027) budget of NIS 548.5M split across R&D infrastructure (NIS 274.5M), research excellence (NIS 203.5M), human capital (NIS 60.5M), regulation (NIS 5M) and program management (NIS 5M); also runs startup-facing initiatives such as the Yes/Boston Innovation Challenge targeting early-stage health, resilience and sustainable food-systems startups.

summary.en: Government Resolution-backed national program (2023-2027, ~NIS 548.5M first phase) jointly financed by the Israel Innovation Authority and four other government bodies to build bioconvergence R&D infrastructure and support health-related biotech/synbio ventures.
summary.local: תוכנית לאומית רב-משרדית (2023-2027, כ-548.5 מיליון ש"ח בשלב הראשון) הממומנת בשיתוף רשות החדשנות ומשרדי ממשלה נוספים לבניית תשתיות מו"פ בביו-קונברגנס ותמיכה במיזמים בתחום הבריאות.

verification_notes: Budget breakdown (infrastructure/research excellence/human capital/regulation/management) corroborated by search-result summary of the program's midterm activity report; program is administered primarily through the Israel Innovation Authority but treated as a distinct entity here given its own brand, dedicated website and multi-ministry Government Resolution funding structure.

strategy.thesis: NIS 1 billion (~$300M) national plan approved by the Israeli government in 2018, run jointly by the Ministry of Health, the Digital Israel Initiative and the Israel Innovation Authority, funding pilot programs and R&D grants that let health tech companies and healthcare organizations (HMOs, hospitals) build and test digital-health and data-sharing infrastructure.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Sub-tracks include the 2018 Digital Health Pilot Program (companies receive 20-50% of approved R&D expenditure, up to 60-75% for high-potential proposals), the 2021 Innovation Program for Health Organizations (NIS 55M / ~$17.6M, up to NIS 8M per health organization for data-sharing infrastructure), and the 2022 Health Organization R&D initiative (NIS 100M / ~$30M across 19 selected programs).

summary.en: Israel's billion-shekel national digital health plan, run by the Health Ministry with the Digital Israel Initiative and the Israel Innovation Authority, funds R&D grants and pilots for health-tech companies and healthcare organizations building digital-health and data-sharing capabilities.
summary.local: תוכנית לאומית בהיקף מיליארד ש"ח, בניהול משרד הבריאות בשיתוף הרשות הדיגיטלית ורשות החדשנות, למימון פיילוטים ומענקי מו"פ לחברות טכנולוגיה רפואית ולארגוני בריאות.

name.en: BIRD Foundation (Israel-U.S. Binational Industrial R&D Foundation)

aka: Binational Industrial Research and Development Foundation

check_size.raw: up to $1.5M per project (covers up to 50% of project cost)

strategy.thesis: Bi-national foundation established by the U.S. and Israeli governments in 1977 to co-fund joint industrial R&D between American and Israeli companies; takes no equity and has funded digital-health and medical-device collaborations (e.g. XRHealth's VR platform with Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center) among its broader tech portfolio.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Matchmaking plus conditional grants covering up to 50% of joint project development costs, up to $1.5M per project, repaid only from future product revenues; no equity taken.

summary.en: Government-established Israel-U.S. binational R&D foundation providing non-dilutive matching grants (up to $1.5M, no equity) for joint American-Israeli industrial R&D projects, including digital-health and medical-device collaborations such as XRHealth's VR platform for perioperative care.
summary.local: קרן דו-לאומית ישראל-ארה"ב שהוקמה על ידי הממשלות ב-1977, מעניקה מענקים תואמים (עד 1.5 מיליון דולר, ללא נטילת הון) לפרויקטי מו"פ תעשייתיים משותפים, כולל בתחומי הבריאות הדיגיטלית והמכשור הרפואי.

name.en: Chief Scientist Office, Ministry of Health (Israel)

aka: Office of the Chief Scientist, Ministry of Health

strategy.thesis: Ministry of Health body that funds and manages investigator-initiated biomedical and clinical research grants performed in Israeli hospitals, universities and research institutes, aiming to translate research into clinical and public-health impact.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Funds investigator-initiated, health-related research projects; maintains the 'Meitar' database of medical research summaries and an online application portal for medical research funding/scholarships.

summary.en: The Israeli Ministry of Health's Chief Scientist Office funds and administers investigator-initiated biomedical and clinical research grants at hospitals, universities and research institutes across Israel.
